messages:
Anika: FYI BlueMantle just flagged a packaging spec change (they moved to a tighter shrinkwrap) and customs flagged 1 container for physical inspection. ETA slips ~+12 days for remainder. This affects some marketplace reservations and a couple of Dedicated commits. Need quick triage.
Marco: Which reservation numbers? can they do a split so we don't lose all stock at once?
Anika: Reservations: BM-9902, BM-9903. BM says they can do split shipments but it adds ~48h handling + extra docs. They can release ~18% of BM-9902 immediately as partial.
Sam: Prioritize Dedicated customers (Acme, Valence) and any active Reserved/commit contracts. Do we have any unallocated buffer we can temporarily borrow?
Lee: Inventory snapshot: EU buffer 12 GPUs, US buffer 0, APAC buffer 2. Shipping EU->US transit is ~3-5 days and ~2 days handling. Marketplace currently still shows available; we should flip to limited immediately.
Carla: @Marco can you ask BlueMantle for an e-manifest + photos of the new shrinkwrap and packing list? I'll open customs broker ticket and request urgent clearance.
Marco: On it. Pinged BM ops (cc: bm-ops@blue.example). partners-bot: logged shipment alert to #partnerships.
partners-bot: BlueMantle update posted: partial split confirmed for BM-9902 (18% released). Remainder ETA +12 days. E-manifest link will be uploaded within 30m — https://blue.example/manifest/BM-9902
Sam: Proposed triage plan: 1) set marketplace SKU to 'limited' for affected SKUs 2) reassign EU buffer to Acme Dedicated pool (10 GPUs) 3) offer marketplace buyers either immediate partial shipment or 8% credit on delayed full shipments. Agree?
Lee: I will push the UI status flag and site banner. Also pausing new allocation jobs for BM SKUs. @Marco hold marketplace replenishment jobs until we see manifest.
Marco: Asked BM to upload airway bill + photos. Also requested packing spec diff. Will update in ~45m.
Anika: I'll tell GTM to pause any BlueMantle marketing comms and joint announcement drafts. Sam/Lee, can you confirm reassign + site banner by EOD?
Sam: Confirmed. Moving 10 GPUs from EU buffer into Acme's Dedicated pool now. Notifying finance to create a provisional credit line for marketplace refunds/credits.
Carla: Customs broker ticket opened (#C-67823). Broker requested original shrinkwrap spec, photos, and exporter declaration. BM rep says docs will be delivered electronically in ~30m.
partners-bot: Log entry created: ticket #C-67823, partial release recorded for BM-9902 (18%). Next automatic check in 90m.
Anika: If we don't get e-manifest within 2h escalate to ops lead and partner SLA owner. I'll keep this thread open until cleared. :eyes: 
Marco: Noted, will escalate at +2h if no doc.
Sam: I'll coordinate comms to Acme (Dedicated) about temporary ETA shifts and credit option, and to marketplace buyers via email template if needed.
Lee: Banner live in ~18m. Allocation jobs paused. Will monitor allocation queue and update if any additional holds appear.
Carla: Broker confirms they'll request an expedited customs slot if we can provide photos; BM said they'd upload in 20m.
Anika: Thanks all. Will reconvene if docs don't arrive or if customs requests additional information. Close unless new blockers appear.
